name: Jethalal Rubbing Eyes in Disbelief
visual_description: Four-panel grid of Jethalal Gada from TMKOC looking shocked, rubbing his eyes, and reacting with stunned disbelief.
usage_context: Used to show complete disbelief, shock, or inability to process an absurd or horrifying situation even after double-checking.

example.caption: When you check your bank balance after a weekend trip

text_areas.description: Situation or revelation that causes shock and disbelief
